sources.name: Google Civic Information API - Elections/voterInfo/divisions
sources.granularity: Election list, polling places, contests/candidates, OCD division IDs (divisionByAddress)
sources.verified_live: Responds (HTTP 403 without API key = service up). Not tested with a key.
sources.notes: Representatives API turned down April 2025 (confirmed by Google group posts; endpoint /representatives still returns the generic 403 so I could not confirm shutdown by probing). Elections and Divisions APIs remain. It has NO vote counts. Useful only for ballot contests/OCD IDs and for joining other datasets.

sources.name: civicAPI (civicapi.org)
sources.latency: Advertises 'up-to-the-minute' results and race calls for the Nov 3 2026 general; actual lag unverified
sources.verified_live: Homepage 200 and has a 'America's Decision 2026' page. API paths I guessed (/api/v2/races returned 502, /api/v2/race/public 404). Real endpoint docs not found. Third-party directories list it as no-auth.
sources.notes: Most promising free live aggregator found, but its data source (likely AP or scraped state feeds) and reliability are unverified. Needs a look at its docs or Embed page and network tab in a browser. Single-vendor risk.

sources.name: Dutchess County BOE results (Enhanced Voting ENR)
sources.latency: Election night, updated as the county uploads; county reportedly posts slowly through evening and next day. Exact interval unverified.
sources.granularity: County contests, likely down to election district and town
sources.verified_live: Page returns 200 (an Angular SPA, title 'Election Results'). Linked from elections.dutchessny.gov homepage as the GE2026 result page. The JSON API behind it was not found: static JS only references Mapbox and /results/public/api/... returned 404.
sources.notes: No documented public API. The SPA must call a backend, so inspect network requests in a real browser (Playwright or Chrome tools) to get the JSON. That would be undocumented, so scraping politely is a risk. Fallback is the official PDFs at elections.dutchessny.gov/election-results/ (page last modified 2026-07-10). Past results were PDFs such as 'GE25 Official Summary Results' and 'ED Contest Overview', posted after election night.
sources.format: HTML SPA backed by undiscovered JSON; PDFs as fallback
sources.official: Official county site, but no sanctioned API

sources.name: NY State Board of Elections results
sources.latency: State posts unofficial results on election night; certification weeks later. Unverified.
sources.granularity: Statewide, county, ED in downloadable files historically
sources.verified_live: Blocked: HTTP 403 Cloudflare 'Just a moment' challenge from curl. results.elections.ny.gov also returned 403. Needs a real browser.
sources.notes: Dutchess BOE points to the state board for additional data. Cloudflare protection makes scripted access hard.

sources.name: Clarity Elections (SOE/Scytl) ENR feeds plus openelections/clarify
sources.latency: Real-time (minutes) on election night, for the jurisdictions that use Clarity (e.g. GA, CO, UT, many counties). Depends on each county.
sources.verified_live: GitHub repo exists, last push 2025-11-12, not archived. web.enr.clarityelections.com did not connect from curl (HTTP 000). Dutchess/NY do NOT use Clarity (they use Enhanced Voting), so this does not help for your county.
sources.notes: Library parses XML zip (reports/detailxml.zip) and JSON endpoints like json/en/summary.json per a wiki (only partly confirmed). Does not do downloading or unzipping for you. Unofficial use of public feeds.
sources.official: Vendor's public feeds, not a documented API

sources.name: OpenElections (openelections-data-ny)
sources.latency: POST-election. Volunteer-cleaned data lags weeks to months after certification. Not live.
sources.granularity: Precinct level CSVs (county files in year/counties folders)
sources.verified_live: GitHub API 200; last push 2026-10-23; latest commit 2026-08-17. Has 2024 directory. Did not confirm presence of 2025/2026 general data.
sources.notes: Great for historical baselines for Dutchess (swing/turnout comparison), not for live. Data API at GitHub raw files.

sources.name: GitHub generic live-results scrapers
sources.verified_live: GitHub search found no maintained, US-wide live scraper. Hits were India/Kenya/demo projects. Only clarify (active-ish) and elex (archived) matter.
sources.notes: No turnkey open-source US live aggregator found. A search for NYT's unofficial JSON endpoint found nothing and would likely violate NYT terms.

summary: Bottom line for the free tier: nothing free and documented gives live US results. The only free live-ish options are (1) civicAPI.org (claims free, up-to-the-minute 2026 results; endpoints unverified, my guesses 502/404, so inspect its Embed/Help pages), and (2) scraping state/county sites. For Dutchess County, the BOE posts results via Enhanced Voting at app.enhancedvoting.com/results/public/dutchess-county-ny/GE2026 (200 OK, Angular SPA). It has no documented API; the backing JSON must be found with browser dev tools, and the county historically posts slowly (PDFs after the night). The NY State BOE site is behind a Cloudflare challenge (403 to curl). Post-election and context sources are all free and working: OpenElections NY (precinct CSVs, pushed 2026-10-23), MIT Election Lab/Harvard Dataverse (API up), FEC (verified returning NY-18 2026 candidates with DEMO_KEY, but it is finance, not results), Wikipedia (live-ish human-edited). Google Civic: Representatives API was shut down April 2025; Elections/Divisions remain (key required, probed: service up, 403 without key) but contain no vote counts. elex is archived since 2022 and needs a paid AP key (api.ap.org returns 401, alive). Clarity/clarify works only for Clarity jurisdictions, and Dutchess is not one. Verdict: a dashboard is feasible, using a paid or semi-official live feed for statewide/national races plus the discovered Enhanced Voting JSON for Dutchess, with OpenElections/MIT for baselines. Caveats: I did not verify civicAPI's real endpoint, nor Enhanced Voting's JSON, nor certain 2025/2026 OpenElections coverage."
